what: Every script whose SHAPE includes deleting or tombstoning a path that is not obviously temporary. The shape is detected mechanically by gate 8; the VERDICT below is hand-read, and each carries its reason. A removal-shaped script in neither this registry nor wired to absence.sanction fails gate 8.

states.WIRED: removes corpus artefacts and calls absence.sanction before doing so
states.NOT-A-CORPUS-REMOVAL: the deleted path is a lock, a probe, a scratch dir or a temp file -- nothing a reader receives
states.HISTORICAL: a one-shot migration that has already been applied; it removes corpus artefacts and is NOT wired, and that is recorded rather than hidden

scripts/retire_2026_08_28.py.why: the 763-page retirement. Wired 2026-08-28: computes the positive restatement, prints both counts, and refuses without RETIRE_EXPLAIN. Verified by dry run -- 756 vs 2, exit 1, nothing written.

scripts/remove_nonpoolable_apps.py.why: one-shot, already applied. It deletes *_REVIEW.html pages selected by a non-poolable predicate. UNWIRED and recorded as such: if it is ever re-run it must be wired first.

scripts/rebuild_paper_corpus_2026_08_20..why: one-shot rebuild that removes and regenerates pages. Already applied. Removal is followed by regeneration from source, so the set is not absence-defined -- but it is not wired and that is stated.

scripts/prune_legacy_corpus_2026_08_26.p.why: the 1,191-page prune. Its own docstring says it is a one-shot whose assertions can never fail again, and it uses an ALLOW-list rather than a deny-list -- the correct shape. Recorded, not wired, because re-running it is already forbidden by its own header.

scripts/lane_daemon.py.why: removes its own per-lane output file between runs

scripts/rerun_bookkeeping_with_lead_ins_.why: removes a quarantine directory it created itself

scripts/clone_contamination_gate.py.why: unlinks its own output file before rewriting it -- absent beats silently-old

scripts/durable_artefact_gate.py.why: removes a probe file it wrote a line earlier

scripts/plant_curated_overwrite_guard.py.why: a plant harness; removes the tree it planted

scripts/verify_engine_metafor_parity.py.why: removes a temp R output file

scripts/test_manuscript_guard.py.why: a test; removes its own fixture

scripts/_js_parse_gate.py.why: unlinks a temp JS file it wrote for node --check
